summary: Design governed skills taxonomies, AI inference controls, and internal talent marketplaces. Build practical HR architecture skills with TrainingCred.
lede: Skills-based organisation design helps senior HR and workforce professionals connect skills evidence to job architecture, learning and internal mobility. Training covers building a controlled skills ontology, mapping skills to roles, and checking data quality and AI-assisted skill inferences. It also addresses learning pathways and governance for internal talent marketplace recommendations, movement decisions and skills-based pay evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior HR and workforce professionals who need to architect, govern, or evaluate skills-based organisation initiatives across talent, learning, analytics, mobility, and rewards.
modules: Ontology Design with ESCO and SFIA
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of talent management, learning and development, HR analytics, organisational design, job architecture, or total rewards. Familiarity with HRIS, LMS, LXP, or talent marketplace workflows will help, but you do not need to administer a specific platform. No coding or programming is required. Advanced AI topics receive conceptual and operational treatment, while ontology design, governance mapping, and dashboard planning receive hands-on application.
